resources.string: Automatic actions by %1$s, such as following your forwarded notes.
When an email arrives, orders run from the top. Actions already done by an order above are skipped. Create, edit and reorder orders on the web.
When you forward an email from one of your trusted addresses with a note on top, %1$s does what the note says. Only your note counts as an instruction. You can turn this order off, but not delete it.
Each note waits as an approval. %1$s starts once you approve.
%1$s starts on the note at once. Each step still follows its own permission, and sending mail always waits for you.
Off: forwarded notes are ordinary mail.
